decisions.description: Upgraded schematic sheet size from A3 to A2 and partitioned all 84 existing components into 8 dashed module containers with bold section titles while preserving 100% of electrical netlist connectivity and PCB parity.

Updated J1 MPN from USB4105-GF-A to Lion Circuits' unhyphenated catalogue MPN USB4105GFA (GCT 16-pin USB 2.0 Type-C horizontal SMT receptacle, 389,128 in stock at INR 101.96) across schematic, PCB, 2-up panel, symbol/footprint libraries, BOM CSVs, and spec files so all 33 BOM lines achieve 100% availability (noOfNotAvailable = 0).
